measurement_rules.callback_intervals: Complete timed callback timestamp differences; floor((n-1)*p) order statistic, including within-window stalls. Callback rate is not physical monitor FPS.
measurement_rules.render_intervals: Actual frame_post_draw submission differences within timed window, not physical display refresh.
measurement_rules.native_delivery_intervals: Derived differences between full-window Main-observed distinct native ticks. Ticks may coalesce; this is not worker execution cadence.
measurement_rules.timed_physics: Actual shared Rapier segment steps and separately completed 1/60-second intervals; per-body native ACK and exact pose echo counts independently retained.
measurement_rules.stage_costs: Window deltas of accumulated instrumentation. Main pump includes waits and its nested Main stages; worker execution can overlap Main wall time; native occupancy includes relocation/contact. Do not add as independent wall time.
measurement_rules.latency_stages: Bounded recent probe samples can include setup and earlier epochs; stage maxima/sample tails are not whole-window cost partitions.
measurement_rules.publication: Coherence samples prove matching published owners. Equal final native/display tick and World revision are recorded after Pause drain, not a running age distribution.
measurement_rules.controls: Disabled and enabled controls share authored recipe/camera/ordinary actor. Enabled fixture installs additional callback/draw coherence observers; enabled-vs-disabled differences include that observer asymmetry.
measurement_rules.recording: Light Tower off/on uses same per-callback sampling, geometry, 180ticks and rendering mode, differing requested recording state. One run each; no statistical causal claim.
